title: 第三章 嚣张的林小姐第二章 可怜见
slug: 快穿之时空星河伴第九章误闯雾山
content_zh:
柳卿像往常一样来到说书先生这里嗑瓜子听些趣事，高兴之际看到那个什么林小姐带着一两个仆人过来了，当中也包括了那个昨夜过来买酒的人。
原来...是她那边的人，怪不得谁这么过分虐待人家呢，不过他这身型倒像是那天看到林小姐带回来那个脏兮兮的人。
那林小姐一来，周围的人对她好像都不太喜欢，看来她在这里的名声不太好呀。柳卿也没太多理会她们，自顾自的磕自己的瓜子，而那个人跟她对视上了，还看了她好一会儿，柳卿便回以微笑，就当是打了个招呼了。
“瘦子，还不快点倒茶，看什么呢？！”
那林小姐随即找了位置坐下便不满的说道。
瘦子拿起茶壶和杯子，倒茶的时候手是有些微微抖着，茶水还不经意间都溅洒了出来。
一个女仆急忙的给林小姐擦着身上的茶水，而她还不忘的怒骂着：“干什么呢！倒个茶都笨手笨脚的，真是笨死了！！”
那瘦子的手不太灵活的把茶壶、杯子放下后，一边低垂着头说道：“对不起、对不起！”
林小姐黑着脸起身，“不听了！！真是个废物，要不是看你长的有几分相貌，早就把你丢出去了，连服侍人都不会！！气死我了！！！”
说罢，她便拿过一个仆人手里备着的小鞭子就往他身上抽。瘦子抱着脑袋一直被她鞭笞着，一声不吭。
周围的看客都有些看不下去，虽然有些不太敢跟这个林小姐作对，毕竟她在这里还是有点地位的，但是呢，这个镇子的人最大的特点就是比较团结，也不完全是个怕事的人，毕竟这个镇子的人比较复杂，都是大大四方聚集在一起的人，什么人、神、精怪、妖都会有......
“别打了、别打了，他刚刚都道歉了，你都抽了这么多下了！！还不停手啊！！！”
“就是呀！真是没人性，快回去把你！别打扰我们在这里听故事！！”
林小姐怒视着众人，小鞭子直接往桌子上抽去，大骂道：“一群贱民也敢说我！！是不是不想活了！！！”
柳卿也看不下去了，在人群里附和着：“快回去吧，别再这里扰人兴致！！不怕哪天就被人打了去！！！”
“就是！！快滚吧！！！”
突然也不知道谁往林小姐身上扔菜叶子，一人扔了之后就有人跟着一起扔了；林小姐带的人少，而且人多势众，她显然弱势了，骂骂咧咧的：“一群贱民竟然敢扔我！啊！！”
一枚鸡蛋直接就扔她头上了，蛋液直接就流到脸上去了，林小姐直接就气炸了，但是目前打不过他（她）们，人太多了，也就只能落荒而逃，道：“走走走！我们走！！”
那些仆人护送着她离开，但是那个瘦子就是不走，一直站在原地低着头。
林小姐直接就喊旁边的仆人去拉他走，但他就是不愿走。她直接怒骂道：“你在不走，信不信我喊人打断你的腿！！！”

突然瘦子拿起桌上的杯子直接摔在地上，茶杯碎掉的声音引起大家的注意，都停下了扔东西的手。林小姐也被他惊到了，气急败坏的指着他说道：“反了你了！！！”
瘦子蹲下捡起地上的碎片直接往脸上划去，一道口子就出来了，还滋滋冒着血。
不仅仅是众人都愣住了，就连柳卿也被他这一行为给惊到了，这么狠？！
林小姐看着他的脸已毁，皱着眉头指着他骂道：“你...那你别回来了！本小姐不要你了，你个恶心的玩意儿！！！”气的甩头就走。
小二看他这脸上的血都流到脖子去了，立马拿了一块干净的布给他擦擦：“赶快去医馆看看吧，你这血一直在流呀！”
他不说话的站在原地，小二看不过去，直接就拉着他去医馆，“你怎么就这么倔呢！那林小姐在这出了名的泼辣，你也真是的……竟然这么冲动，不过不得不佩服你，真是对自己下的了手！！”
瘦子对于小二的话也不知道这算是对他的褒义还是贬义了。
柳卿磕着瓜子直摇头，真是个狠人！不过他这一出倒算是给了他自己一条生路了，不至于继续待在那个林小姐身边，不然不得天天被虐待，那这脸上划的这一道也还算是值了的，对于林小姐来说，他相貌已毁就没太大必要留在身边玩儿了。
毕竟她好男色，那相貌都没了，她自然就看不上了。
柳卿看了看天色也渐渐落山，回小酒馆干饭去咯。吃饱喝足的她来到后院一个小溪边，坐在粗大的树干上喝着小酒，看着那小溪缓缓流淌着清澈的水，还有小小鱼儿在游荡着，她捡起一块小石子百般无赖在手上把玩着，随即往小溪抛了过去，“弹、弹、弹——”，这打水漂还挺好玩儿。
她看着天空那耀眼的光辉，橙色的犹如烈火一般的火烧云，忍不住感叹：“真美呀~”
有种久违的感觉，在星际很难看的到这种这么自然的风景了。
坐了许久许久，天色渐晚；柳卿坐的腰都酸了，起身活动了下，拿起酒瓶就往屋里去，随即就出了大门，然而被叶哥喊住了：“干嘛去？！”
柳卿扭了扭脖子，活动了一下肩膀，道：“打算出街走走。”
“去吧去吧，姑娘家的别太晚回来。”叶哥摆了摆手。
来到街上看着热闹的众人，街边上都有很多摆摊的，突然看到有个卖糖葫芦的，顿时有点嘴馋就买了一根，一口咬下去吃起来的那一刻都忍不住翻起了白眼，“哟、哟、哟！酸、真酸！！”
酸中又带点甜，“嘶~酸的真爽。”她喜欢，就是有点酸掉牙了。
每吃一口都是一副难以言喻的表情，就......就酸的上头。
逛着逛着，有个身型特别眼熟，那人走路慢悠悠的不太利索，她紧跟过去发现是那个瘦子。她也不知道他会去哪儿，估计会去找他自己的家里人吧。
她一路跟着，看着他好像是觉得身体不舒服还是怎么的，他找了个没什么人的小巷就静静的坐在那里，那身影看着格外的可怜。

她一路都在观察他，他也没发现她，她没进去那个小巷，而是径直的走了。

content_en:
As usual, Liu Qing came to the storyteller to eat melon seeds and listen to some interesting stories. When she was happy, she saw Miss Lin coming with one or two servants, including the person who came to buy wine last night.
It turned out... that he was from her side. No wonder he was so cruel to her, but his figure looked like the dirty man he saw Miss Lin bring back that day.
When Miss Lin came, everyone around her didn't seem to like her very much. It seems that her reputation here is not very good. Liu Qing didn't pay much attention to them, and was minding her own business. The man caught her eye and looked at her for a while. Liu Qing smiled back and took it as a greeting.
"Skinny man, why don't you hurry up and pour the tea? What are you looking at?!"
Miss Lin immediately found a place to sit down and said dissatisfied.
The thin man picked up the teapot and cup. His hands were shaking slightly when he poured the tea, and the tea spilled out unintentionally.
A maid hurriedly wiped the tea off Miss Lin's body, and she still cursed angrily: "What are you doing! I can't even pour tea. I'm so stupid!!"
The thin man put down the teapot and cup with awkward hands, then lowered his head and said, "I'm sorry, I'm sorry!"
Miss Lin stood up with a dark face, "I won't listen anymore!! What a waste. If you hadn't looked at your looks, I would have thrown you out long ago. You can't even serve people!! I'm so angry!!!"
After saying that, she took a small whip prepared by a servant and whipped him. The thin man held his head and was whipped by her without saying a word.
The onlookers around could not stand it, although some did not dare to go against Miss Lin. After all, she still had some status here. However, the biggest characteristic of the people in this town was that they were relatively united and not necessarily afraid of trouble. After all, the people in this town were more complicated. They were all gathered together from all directions. There were all kinds of people, gods, spirits, and monsters...
"Stop it, stop it. He just apologized and you've been slapped so many times!! You still haven't stopped!!!"
"That's right! It's so inhumane. Go back and catch you! Don't disturb us here to listen to the story!!"
Miss Lin glared at everyone, whipped the small whip directly to the table, and cursed: "A group of untouchables dare to talk about me!! Do you not want to live anymore!!!"
Liu Qing couldn't stand it anymore, and echoed in the crowd: "Go back quickly, don't disturb people here anymore!! I'm not afraid of being beaten one day!!!"
"That's right!! Get out of here!!!"
Suddenly, no one knew who was throwing vegetable leaves at Miss Lin. After one person threw it, others followed suit. Miss Lin had few people with her, and she was outnumbered. She was obviously weak, and she cursed: "A group of untouchables dare to throw it at me! Ah!!"
An egg was thrown directly on her head, and the egg liquid flowed directly onto her face. Miss Lin was immediately furious, but she couldn't defeat them at the moment. There were too many people, so she could only run away and said: "Let's go! Let's go!!"
The servants escorted her away, but the thin man refused to leave and kept standing there with his head lowered.
Miss Lin directly called the servant next to her to pull him away, but he just refused to leave. She yelled angrily: "If you don't leave, believe it or not, I will call someone to break your legs!!!"
Suddenly the thin man picked up the cup on the table and threw it to the ground. The sound of the cup breaking caught everyone's attention and they all stopped throwing things. Miss Lin was also shocked by him. She pointed at him angrily and said, "You're against me!!!"
The thin man squatted down and picked up the fragments on the ground and scratched his face directly. A cut came out, and it was still bleeding.
Not only everyone was stunned, but even Liu Qing was shocked by his behavior. So cruel? !
Miss Lin looked at his ruined face, frowned, pointed at him and cursed: "You... then don't come back! I don't want you anymore, you disgusting thing!!!" He shook his head angrily and left.
The waiter saw that the blood on his face was flowing to his neck, and immediately took a clean cloth to wipe him: "Go to the medical center quickly, you are bleeding all the time!"
He stood there without saying a word. The waiter couldn't see it and took him to the hospital directly, "Why are you so stubborn! Miss Lin is famous for being aggressive here, and you are really... so impulsive, but I have to admire you, you really did this to yourself!!"
The thin man didn't know whether the waiter's words were a compliment or a derogation to him.
Liu Qing knocked on the melon seeds and shook her head. What a cruel person! However, his appearance gave him a way out. He would not continue to stay with Miss Lin, otherwise he would be abused every day, so the scratch on his face was still worth it. For Miss Lin, there was no need to stay with him since his appearance was ruined.
After all, she is so masculine, and if her looks are gone, she will naturally not be interested in her.
Liu Qing looked at the sky and it was gradually setting, and went back to the tavern to cook. After eating and drinking, she came to a stream in the backyard, sat on a thick tree trunk and drank a small drink. She looked at the clear water flowing slowly in the stream, and the small fish swimming around. She picked up a small stone and played with it in her hands. Then she threw it into the stream, "Bounce, bounce, bounce-", which was quite fun.
She looked at the dazzling light in the sky, the orange fire-like clouds, and couldn't help but sigh: "It's so beautiful~"
It feels like I haven't seen it for a long time. It's rare to see such natural scenery in the interstellar.
After sitting for a long time, it was getting late. Liu Qing's waist was sore from sitting. She got up and moved around. She picked up the bottle and went into the house. Then she walked out of the door. However, she was stopped by Brother Ye: "Why are you going?!"
Liu Qing twisted her neck, moved her shoulders, and said, "I plan to go out for a walk."
"Go, go, girl, don't come back too late." Brother Ye waved his hand.
I came to the street and watched the lively people. There were many stalls on the street. Suddenly I saw a man selling candied haws. I was a little greedy and bought one. The moment I took a bite, I couldn't help but roll my eyes, "Yo, yo, yo! Sour, so sour!!"
It was sour but also a little sweet, "Hiss~ It's so sour and refreshing." She liked it, but it was a bit sour that she lost her teeth.
Every time I took a bite, I had an indescribable expression on my face, and it just... made me sour.
While walking around, there was a figure who looked particularly familiar. He walked slowly and awkwardly. She followed closely and found that it was the thin man. She didn't know where he would go, he would probably go to his own family.
She followed him all the way, looking at him as if he felt unwell or something. He found a deserted alley and sat there quietly. His figure looked particularly pitiful.
She was observing him all the way, but he didn't notice her. She didn't go into the alley, but walked straight away.
